Lodging: YouLi mentions "the guest house" once (Day 11) and names no Kathmandu hotel. Confirm guesthouses every night on the trek, and name the hotel or keep it general.
Lho, Day 7: YouLi gives 3,180 m and 10,230 ft, which do not match. Which is right? I have used the feet figure.
Day 5 image is the Everest Gokyo trip's Day 5 photo (YouLi also tags Day 5 with a Namche Bazar location). Replace with a Deng or Budhi Gandaki photo? I have not used it.

seo.title: Manaslu Circuit Trek — 16 Days in Nepal | Adventure Access
seo.description: Sixteen days around the world's eighth-highest peak: remote villages, monasteries and Larkya La at 16,929 feet. From $3,180.

hero.title: Manaslu
hero.subtitle: Around the world's eighth-highest peak and over Larkya La at 16,929 feet
hero.imageAlt: Manaslu's snowy summit above a dark ridge

intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Away from the Crowds
paragraphs: The Manaslu Circuit goes all the way around the world's eighth-highest peak. Unlike the crowded Everest and Annapurna regions, it pairs natural beauty and rich culture with real Himalayan wilderness.
Expect remote mountain villages, ancient monasteries and dramatic landscapes, and a crossing of Larkya La at 16,929 feet. It is challenging, and one of Nepal's most rewarding treks.

dayTypes.label: How the Days Work
dayTypes.heading: Slowly, Slowly
dayTypes.lede: Slow and steady is the mantra for trekking in Nepal. We move at a calculated pace so we do not burn you out early or rush the acclimatization process.

cards.title: Trekking days
cards.body: Days 4–14: about 5–7 hours a day. Leave after breakfast, stop for lunch on the trail, and arrive mid-afternoon to rest.

cards.title: Acclimatization day
cards.body: Day 9: climb high, sleep low. A hike to the base of Manaslu and Birendra Lake, then a second night in Samagaon.

cards.title: Kathmandu and road days
cards.body: Days 1–2 and 15–16 in Kathmandu, with long drives on Days 3, 14 and 15 to reach and leave the trail.

chapters.label: The Journey in Chapters
chapters.heading: Around the Eighth-Highest Peak
chapters.lede: Altitudes are for where you stop each night unless noted.

groups.title: Kathmandu — Arrival and Orientation

image.alt: The eyes of Boudhanath stupa under prayer flags

prose: Your guide meets you at the airport, so there is no need to find your hotel in the back alleys of Boudha or Thamel on your own. There is still plenty of time to explore the city, eat well and get to know your guide before the mountains.

days.label: Day 1
days.text: Arrive in Kathmandu, meet your guide and transfer to your hotel.

days.label: Day 2
days.text: A cultural tour in Boudha, the trip orientation, and dinner with your guide and group.

groups.title: Budhi Gandaki — Into the Manaslu Region

image.alt: A suspension bridge across a dry hillside

prose: A long drive along the Budhi Gandaki River brings you to Machha Khola, the entry point to the Manaslu region and a glimpse of rural life in Nepal. From there the valley narrows as its walls begin to tower overhead.

days.label: Day 3
days.text: An 8–9 hour drive, about 160 km, from Kathmandu to Machha Khola. Altitude 2,952 ft.

days.label: Day 4
days.text: A narrow trail and your first suspension bridge, to Jagat, the checkpoint for the Manaslu Conservation Area. 5–6 hours · 22 km · 4,625 ft.

days.label: Day 5
days.text: Through Chisapani and Eklebjatti, with diverse plants and wildlife, to Deng. 7–8 hours · 20 km · 5,915 ft.

groups.title: Nubri — Monasteries and the North Face

image.alt: Trekkers with packs walking toward snowy mountains

prose: As the circuit enters the Nubri region, Tibetan influence grows stronger. The first views of the Manaslu range come at Namrung, and a local Tibetan monastery at Lho and Pungyen Monastery beyond it add to the culture of the route.

days.label: Day 6
days.text: Trek to Namrung and a first look at the Manaslu range. 6–7 hours · 19 km (about 12 mi) · 8,626 ft.

days.label: Day 7
days.text: Trek to Lho, with views of Manaslu and Ganesh Himal. 4–5 hours · 16 km (about 10 mi) · 10,230 ft.

days.label: Day 8
days.text: Trek to Samagaon via Pungyen Monastery, with views of Manaslu's North Face. 5–6 hours · 16 km (about 10 mi) · 11,578 ft.

days.label: Day 9
days.text: Acclimatization day: hike to the base of Manaslu and Birendra Lake, then back to Samagaon for the night.

groups.title: Larkya La — Over the Top
groups.badge: ✦ The high point of the circuit

image.alt: Prayer flags at the Larkya La pass sign

prose: Above the tree line, your surroundings start to match what you have imagined the Himalaya look like. Two shorter days take you up past Larkya Bazaar to Dharmashala, then the longest day of the trek crosses Larkya La.

days.label: Day 10
days.text: Along the Budhi Gandaki, then gradually up to Samdo. 3–4 hours · 10 km (about 6 mi) · 12,661 ft.

days.label: Day 11
days.text: Past Larkya Bazaar, a seasonal Tibetan market, down to the river and over a wooden bridge, then up with views of the Larkya glacier. 4–5 hours · 11 km (about 7 mi) · 14,628 ft.

days.label: Day 12
days.text: An early start over Larkya La at 16,929 ft, with views of Himlung Himal, Kangaru peak and Annapurna II, then down to Bhimthang. 8–9 hours · 24 km (about 15 mi) · 12,202 ft.

groups.title: Tilje to Kathmandu — The Way Down

image.alt: Rhododendrons in bloom below misty peaks

prose: The trail drops through rhododendron forest to join the Annapurna Circuit at Dharapani. From there it is two days by road back to Kathmandu.

days.label: Day 13
days.text: Descend through rhododendron forest to Tilje, with mountain views along the way. 5–6 hours · 16 km (about 10 mi) · 7,544 ft.

days.label: Day 14
days.text: Four hours down to Dharapani on the Annapurna Circuit trail, lunch, then a 6-hour drive to Besisahar for the evening.

days.label: Day 15
days.text: Back to Kathmandu by private jeep on the Prithvi Highway. 6–7 hours · 180 km.

days.label: Day 16
days.text: Your guide picks you up at the hotel and takes you to the airport for your flight.

pullQuote: Slowly, slowly. This is the mantra for trekking in Nepal.

highlights.body: The longest day of the trek crosses the pass at 16,929 feet, with views of the Larkya glacier on the way up.

highlights.title: Tibetan Villages and Monasteries

goodToKnow.label: Good to Know
goodToKnow.heading: Before You Go
goodToKnow.lede: A few things that shape how this trip runs.

cards.title: Kathmandu
cards.body: Your guide meets you at the airport and takes care of the details. Your time in the city includes good food, getting to know your guide and an orientation for the trek.

cards.title: Pace
cards.body: Trek days average 5–7 hours. We leave each village after breakfast, stop for lunch along the way and arrive mid-afternoon to rest for the next day.

cards.title: Acclimatization
cards.body: Climb high, sleep low. On Day 9 we hike higher from Samagaon and return for a second night at the same altitude, which helps the body adjust and reduces the risk of altitude sickness.

cards.title: Larkya La
cards.body: Day 12 is the longest day of hiking, 8–9 hours over the pass at 16,929 feet, so we start early. The trek is challenging; come ready for it.

cards.title: Long drives
cards.body: Reaching and leaving the trail takes time: 8–9 hours to Machha Khola at the start, and 6 hours then 6–7 hours by road at the end.
